crossRefs.note: “Moreover you shall make the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, and blue, and purple, and scarlet, with…
The length of each curtain shall be twenty-eight cubits, and the width of each curtain four cubits: all the curtains…
the Tent of Meeting, the ark of the covenant, the mercy seat that is on it, all the furniture of the Tent,
All the wise-hearted men among those who did the work made the tabernacle with ten curtains of fine twined linen, blue…
